brief:
Fifty-three countries and organizations have urged the Israeli government to permit humanitarian assistance into all parts of the Gaza Strip without obstruction, according to Palestine News Network. The call demands that aid reach Gaza rapidly through all available border crossings and land routes.

The statement, issued in New York, represents a coordinated international push for unimpeded access to the territory amid ongoing concerns about the humanitarian situation.
dek: NEW YORK, November/PNN/ Fifty-three countries and organizations have called on the Israeli government to allow humanitarian assistance to reach all parts of the Gaza Strip rapidly and without obstruction through all available border crossings and land routes.
title: 53 nations call on Israel to open Gaza aid routes
